fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on disaster relief following the 1928 hurricane and flooding in Florida (including criticism of National Red Cross operations and accounts from the Lake Okeechobee/Belle Glade area), along with local political and civic coverage (Hialeah city administration and a taxpayers league; discussion of gambling and accusations of newspaper “protection” payments; municipal airport management; and a bond issue dispute involving the Florida Inland Navigation District). Also features entertainment and society items (Little Theatre/Civic Theatre, Olympia/Temple Theatre concerns), hurricane-related reports from Bimini/Gun Cay and liquor shipping, and recurring humor and short columns.
